_README: The editorial company that publishes this publication, as search engines and answer engines should know it.
scripts/lib/head_seo.py reads this file for every Organization node naming this publication or its editorial company;
scripts/validators/validate_entity_graph.py fails the release if a page disagrees with it;
scripts/entity_backlink_watch.py checks each sameAs weekly and self-heals this file.
sameAs lists ONLY real, independently hosted profiles that resolve now. Never this site's own pages (that is not an
independent identity) and never an invented profile. A profile named but not yet claimed goes in profiles_pending;
the weekly watch promotes it once it resolves and links back.
parentOrganization is null by owner decision (11 Oct 2026): each publication is published by its own editorial
company and names no parent. scripts/validators/validate_no_parent_company.py blocks one on any page.
name: Memphis Vendor Library Editorial Desk
description: The editorial company that writes, edits and publishes Memphis Vendor Library.
